summary: Build skills inventories, mobility workflows, and talent dashboards. Enroll in talent intelligence and internal mobility training for HR professionals.
lede: Talent intelligence training covers how to use workforce skills data to connect people with internal roles and career paths. It is designed for HR, talent management, workforce-planning and people-analytics professionals building a practical internal mobility process. Learners practice creating skills inventories and role-to-skill maps, setting mobility rules, and tracking movement and retention with workforce dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage internal movement, workforce capability, and succession pathways across the organization.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of HR, talent management, or workforce planning processes, plus confidence interpreting basic workforce data such as headcount, turnover, vacancy, and internal transfer rates. No coding is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets and HRIS reporting is helpful, and experience with job architecture, skills frameworks, or succession planning will make the exercises easier to apply.
